desc: Derive the per-query minimum formula: `max(ceil(total_required_divisions / 2), maximum_individual_required_divisions)`.
Design and implement an O(log₄ r) base-4 block/prefix calculation for total required divisions over `[l, r]`.
Verify the implementation against provided examples, odd workload cases, and boundaries at `4^k - 1` and `4^k`.
